name: Visual difference
description: A screenshot no longer matches its committed baseline. Open the diff before anything else.

name: Target host unavailable
description: The demo host refused, reset or timed out a connection. Check the other engine in the same run before touching a test.
messageRegex: (?s).*(net::ERR_|ECONNRESET|ECONNREFUSED|ETIMEDOUT|ENOTFOUND|socket hang up|502 Bad Gateway|503 Service|504 Gateway).*

name: Timed out
description: A step or the case outlived its budget. Usually a locator that no longer matches, sometimes a slow host.

name: Assertion failed
description: The application answered, and the answer was not the expected one.

name: Parked on a known defect
description: Cases parked with test.fixme(). Each names a defect recorded in specs/STATUS.md.
